# Forward-chaining check of the rule system.
facts = {
    ("suspects", "duck", "butterfly"),
    ("not_hug", "ant", "flamingo"),
    ("name", "fish", "Paco"),
    ("name", "reindeer", "Peddi"),
}

def step(f):
    new = set(f)
    # Rule1: reindeer hugs crab if its name starts with same letter as fish's name
    n = {k: v for (t, k, v) in f if t == "name"}
    if "reindeer" in n and "fish" in n and n["reindeer"][0] == n["fish"][0]:
        new.add(("hug", "reindeer", "crab"))
    # Rule2: whoever suspects butterfly also suspects otter
    for (t, a, b) in f:
        if t == "suspects" and b == "butterfly":
            new.add(("suspects", a, "otter"))
    # Rule3: ant does not hug flamingo -> flamingo reveals secret to otter
    if ("not_hug", "ant", "flamingo") in f:
        new.add(("reveals", "flamingo", "otter"))
    # Rule4: flamingo reveals to otter and duck suspects otter -> otter does NOT hide cards from dragon
    if ("reveals", "flamingo", "otter") in f and ("suspects", "duck", "otter") in f:
        new.add(("not_hide", "otter", "dragon"))
    return new

f = facts
while True:
    g = step(f)
    if g == f:
        break
    f = g

hides = ("hide", "otter", "dragon") in f
not_hides = ("not_hide", "otter", "dragon") in f

print("Derived facts:", sorted(f))
print("otter hides cards from dragon derived:", hides)
print("otter does NOT hide cards derived:", not_hides)

if hides and not not_hides:
    verdict = "proved"
elif not_hides and not hides:
    verdict = "disproved"
else:
    verdict = "unknown"
print("Computed verdict:", verdict)

claimed = "proved"  # submitted "Proven"
print("Claimed verdict:", claimed)
print("CHECK PASS" if verdict == claimed else "CHECK FAIL")
